mostWorthwhile.text: Making the paper lantern frame clarified how the paper would contribute to the floating lantern.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final attachment was predictable once the lantern and float were ready.

surprise.text: The floating lantern used paper made from pulp; its role was initially unclear.
